_comment: Copy me to astronauts/<your-handle>.json. Everything except handle and name is optional — a profile with blanks in it is a profile, and the roster would rather show a gap than a guess. Nobody edits your file but you. Delete this _comment line when you fill it in.
name: Your Name
role: what you're aboard for — pilot, botanist, ballast, undecided
avatarAlt: a sentence describing your avatar, for anyone who can't see it
bio: Who you are and why you're going. Any length.
diet: Allergies, restrictions, things you won't eat and things you can't. Say 'none' if none — the galley would rather be told nothing is needed than be left guessing.
health: Anything the mission should know. 'Nothing to declare' is a complete answer.
